name: Team Workload

native.query: SELECT assignee_id, COUNT(*) as open_tasks FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_tasks WHERE status IN ('TODO','IN_PROGRESS') AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY open_tasks DESC

SELECT ms.name, p.name as project, ms.due_date, ms.completion_pct FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_milestones ms JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.project_projects p ON p.id = ms.project_id WHERE ms.completion_pct < 100 ORDER BY ms.due_date
